criteria.text: Diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease; treatment initiated at mild cognitive impairment or mild dementia stage
Patient is 50 years of age or older
Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist
Beta-amyloid plaques verified by PET scan or CSF testing
Documented brain MRI within the last year showing no localized superficial siderosis, fewer than 10 brain microhemorrhages, and no brain hemorrhages greater than 1 cm in the past year
Objective evidence of cognitive impairment at screening
Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) global score of 0.5
Mini-Mental State Exam (MMSE) score of at least 24
Other known causes of dementia ruled out (including vascular dementia and Parkinson's disease dementia)
Not taking blood thinners other than aspirin 81 mg or less
No brain hemorrhage, bleeding disorder, or cerebrovascular abnormalities in the last 6 months
No significant systemic illness or infection in the past 30 days
No unstable angina, myocardial infarction, advanced chronic heart failure, or clinically significant conduction abnormalities within 1 year prior to screening

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Aduhelm (aducanumab-avwa), an amyloid beta-directed antibody, Criteria Version 1: Original 7/16/2021; Approval 9/17/21; Effective 11/1/21. The effective_date remains 2021-11-01.

Encoded: approval criteria 1-9, with the closed Alzheimer's disease indication restricted to initiation at mild cognitive impairment or mild dementia stage per the PDF FDA indications; denial criteria 2-5 are approval-blocking predicates. Denial criterion 1 is failure to meet approval criteria.

Initial approval: up to 3 months. Reauthorization: up to 6 months if MRI obtained prior to the 7th and 12th doses shows no increase in size or number of ARIA-H, and documented evidence shows positive response, slowed rate of cognitive decline, and no adverse reactions. These reauthorization requirements are notes only, not fully predicated.

ARIA caution: enhanced clinical vigilance during the first 8 doses, particularly titration. Symptoms suggestive of ARIA require clinical evaluation, including MRI testing if indicated. ARIA imaging schedule and monitoring are not fully predicated; this pack remains partial.

PDL context only: Aduhelm is non-preferred in ALZHEIMER'S AGENTS. Leqembi is a same-class anti-amyloid alternative, subject to its own criteria and separate evaluation. Kisunla remains text_only. Preferred oral Alzheimer's agents such as donepezil are PDL context only; no oral step-therapy requirement is encoded.
